description: Documentation file for the Keyboard class in a software project, detailing its API, methods, usage examples, and behavior for managing virtual keyboard interactions in a web automation context.

classes.name: Keyboard
classes.description: A class providing an API to simulate keyboard interactions, including key presses, releases, text input, and complex combinations for web automation.

methods.name: Keyboard.down
methods.description: Dispatches a keydown event for the specified key, supporting modifiers and generating corresponding keyboard events.

methods.name: Keyboard.up
methods.description: Dispatches a keyup event for the specified key, releasing any modifier or key that was previously pressed.

methods.name: Keyboard.insertText
methods.description: Dispatches an input event with specified text, without emitting keydown or keyup events, suitable for inserting text directly.

methods.name: Keyboard.press
methods.description: Simulates pressing a key with optional delay, supporting complex key combinations.

methods.name: Keyboard.type
methods.description: Types a string directly by sending keydown, keypress/input, and keyup events for each character.

search-terms: API for managing keyboard in browser automation
